name: Augustus Pablo
hook: A schoolroom melodica became the lead voice of dub, on records King Tubby stripped down to almost nothing.
blurb: Born Horace Swaby, Pablo learned the melodica at school in Kingston, an instrument treated as a classroom novelty everywhere else in popular music, and built almost all his work on it, using it as a lead instrument on reggae instrumentals, which nobody else was doing. He worked closely with King Tubby, who remixed Pablo's rhythms into some of the most famous dub records ever made. Their 1976 album 'King Tubbys Meets Rockers Uptown' is widely considered one of the defining dub records, pairing Pablo's minor-key melodica lines with Tubby's spare, cavernous mixing.

signatureTracks.title: King Tubby Meets Rockers Uptown
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: Pablo's melodica over a Tubby mix stripped to drum, bass, and echo; the melodica occupies the space a vocal would normally take.

signatureTracks.title: East of the River Nile
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: A full album of melodica-led dub, and the clearest showcase of Pablo as a bandleader rather than a guest voice.
